place!

text_block_list.text:

really fast, and then suddenly, there was 
nobody in front of me!

text_block_list.text:
"The wind is super strong at the front! 
Did you know? I had no idea!"

text_block_list.text:
And also, the Winner's Circle is super 
green! It feels just a tiny bit rough to 
the touch!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And also, and also! Let's see, let's see!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Taking 1st place really was so much fun! 
Taking 1st place was super, super fun!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I want to win way more 1st 
places!
